instructions_to_main_agent.threejs_implementation_rules: Use R3F and drei. The BWP Technology section MUST include a true 3D exploded view of plywood layers. Do not just use images. Create simple box geometries mapped with the provided plywood_exploded_reference or solid dark wood colors and animate their Y-axis separation on scroll using framer-motion-3d useScroll.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.styling_rules: Never use pure black or gray; always tint. Ensure overlay text over the hero image is perfectly readable (e.g., using text-shadow or a delicate dark gradient overlay). Use optical alignment and generous paddings.
